name: server-snapshot-coalescing
description: Verify a production stat burst produces bounded complete snapshots and the real client receives the final values and catalogs.

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation c:Invoke('Reset') c:Invoke('SetStats',{Coins=0,Score=0,TrainingActive=0}) task.wait(.15) return H:JSONEncode({ok=true})

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local RS=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage') if shared.SmashSnapshotProbe and shared.SmashSnapshotProbe.connection then shared.SmashSnapshotProbe.connection:Disconnect() end local probe={received=0} shared.SmashSnapshotProbe=probe probe.connection=RS.PunchWallEvents.StatsChanged.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload) probe.received+=1 probe.latest=payload end) return H:JSONEncode({ok=true})

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] local counts={} for _,player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do counts[player]=player:GetAttribute('StatsSnapshotCount') or 0 end local before=counts[p] for i=1,160 do p.leaderstats.Coins.Value=i p.leaderstats.Score.Value=i*10 p.RPGStats.WallXP.Value=i end local synchronous=(p:GetAttribute('StatsSnapshotCount') or 0)-before assert(synchronous==0,'ordinary burst sent synchronous snapshots') task.wait(.16) local bounded=true local deltas={} for player,count in pairs(counts) do local delta=(player:GetAttribute('StatsSnapshotCount') or 0)-count deltas[tostring(player.UserId)]=delta bounded=bounded and delta>=1 and delta<=2 end assert(bounded,'burst snapshot count unbounded '..H:JSONEncode(deltas)) return H:JSONEncode({ok=bounded,synchronous=synchronous,deltas=deltas,coins=p.leaderstats.Coins.Value,score=p.leaderstats.Score.Value,xp=p.RPGStats.WallXP.Value})

steps.label: 480 ordinary changes flush once per player with one idle-tick allowance

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local probe=shared.SmashSnapshotProbe local deadline=os.clock()+3 repeat local s=probe.latest if s and s.Coins==160 and s.Score==1600 and s.WallXP==160 then break end task.wait(.03) until os.clock()>=deadline local s=probe.latest or {} local ok=s.Coins==160 and s.Score==1600 and s.WallXP==160 and type(s.FistCatalog)=='table' and #s.FistCatalog==16 and type(s.PetCatalog)=='table' and #s.PetCatalog==16 and type(s.TrainingConfig)=='table' and type(s.Leaderboard)=='table' if probe.connection then probe.connection:Disconnect() end shared.SmashSnapshotProbe=nil assert(ok,'client did not receive complete final burst state') return H:JSONEncode({ok=ok,coins=s.Coins,score=s.Score,xp=s.WallXP,catalogCount=#s.FistCatalog})

steps.label: real client receives complete final state
